classes.name: Core::NodeId
classes.description: A class representing a network node identifier, with methods to access hostname, type, port, and interface properties.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes NodeId with a hostname and port.

methods.description: Returns the hostname component of the NodeId.

methods.description: Checks if the NodeId is valid.
